label.vi: Chữ trắng viền đậm, từ đang nói đổi màu
label.en: Bold outlined captions, current word highlighted

description: No background: white heavy text with a thick dark outline and a soft shadow, 2-5 word groups on at most 2 lines; the word being spoken turns the accent colour, keywords stay accent with a small pop. The default caption look.

keywords.doc: words that stay in the accent colour (product names, numbers, the CTA name)

top.doc: top edge as a fraction of frame height; keep it above the app's buttons and description (<= 0.75 on TikTok/Reels)

size.doc: font size as a fraction of frame width
